# How to Cite {.unnumbered}

If you use this book or any individual chapter, please cite using the DOIs below.

## Book

Mayer, T., Bhandari, B., & Saah, D. (2026). EarthRISE Applied Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning Book. Zenodo. [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20547796](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20547796)

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.20547796.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20547796)
:::

**BibTeX:**

```bibtex
@book{mayer2026earthrise,
  title     = {EarthRISE Applied Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning Book},
  author    = {Mayer, Tim and Bhandari, Biplov and Saah, David},
  year      = {2026},
  publisher = {Zenodo},
  doi       = {10.5281/zenodo.20547796},
  url       = {https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20547796}
}
```
